utility.name: Hackerbot3
utility.author: Mission Deny the Mission
utility.description: Hackerbot 3: Hackerbot 2 (IRC attack chatbot with LLM fallback) plus a canned-response decision router. Before falling back to the LLM, each student question is scored by a small decision model (e.g. Clef-Flash on vLLM) against the lab's curated question/answer pairs (opt_hackerbot3/decision/pairs/); confident matches get the instructor-written answer, everything else goes to the LLM as in Hackerbot 2. Attack/quiz/flag flow is unchanged, so hackerbot_config generators written for Hackerbot 2 (hb2_*) work as-is. The router is configured at build time with secgen.rb --hb3-* options (or HB3_* env vars) and per bot with a <decision_router> element in the bot XML; with no decision URL it is off and the bot behaves like Hackerbot 2. Connects to an IRC server on localhost (put an ircd on the same VM).
